contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 75.00' on p51, equal to the cover's 'Totals for This Report' cell (75.00)
contributions.detail: 1 Form A row (75.00) equals the schedule's printed total = the cover's This-Report column. Cumulative is 1,575.00 with 1,500.00 from the last report (1,500.00 + 75.00 = 1,575.00, so this cover's own arithmetic closes), which makes the schedule PERIOD-scoped: the 1,500.00 raised before June 14 is not itemized on this October-8 pre-election report. No figure was synthesized by differencing covers - the This-Report cell is printed here. 2024 3-line variant, no separate <=$50 aggregate line. No in-kind rows, so both in-kind conventions agree.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report): 78.99' on p52, equal to the cover's 'Totals for This Report' cell (78.99)
expenditures.detail: 3 Form B rows (31.98 + 30.03 + 16.98) sum to 78.99 exactly = the schedule's printed total = the cover's This-Report column; cumulative 1,519.17 = 1,440.18 last + 78.99 this, so the cover closes and the schedule is period-scoped. The cover's This-Report ending balance is printed in accounting parentheses as (3.99) because the period spent 3.99 more than it raised; that cell is not an itemized side and is untouched here.

escalation_note: Five 600 dpi tight --value crops. Two were EXPLORATORY, needed because neither schedule page yielded any v_rules: a wide amount-column strip on each page (pct:14.0,6.18,20.0,10.27@p51 and pct:14.0,5.45,20.0,9.96@p52) rendered the printed row rules together with the amounts, letting the row boundaries be measured against a known window instead of estimated. Three were A3 proofs: p51 row 1 rendered 75.00; p52 row 1 rendered 31.98 and row 3 rendered 16.98. No legibility escalation was needed. NOTE: 900 dpi was not used on this 2024 combined archive - see the sibling record 7bbe69af, where 900 dpi returns blank crops on this file's oversized pages; 600 dpi renders cleanly here (these three pages are ordinary 612x792 pt letter pages, unlike pp.161-164).

51.measure_note: ROTATED LANDSCAPE SHEET rendered portrait: the printed text reads bottom-to-top and the table's ROWS advance LEFT-TO-RIGHT across the rendered page, so axis='x'. That inverts the usual reading of the detector: the COLUMN bands are the HORIZONTAL rules (h_rules_pct = [6.18,16.45,56.86,85.8,93.55] -> Amount / Address / Name / Date, top to bottom) and the ROW bands would be the vertical ones. rowbands detected NO v_rules on this page, so the single row band was HAND-MEASURED from an exploratory crop: a strip of the amount column from x=14.0 to x=34.0 rendered the printed row rules at 14.44 / 17.39 / 20.45 / 23.50 / 26.55 / 29.51 / 32.76 pct, with the '75.00' sitting between 17.39 and 20.45; the band before it (14.44-17.39) is the form's blank spacer and the header label 'Amount' lies left of 14.44 - both NON-DATA and excluded. Only the one used row is stored. cell is the AMOUNT column band. PROOF (A3): pct:17.39,6.18,3.06,10.27@p51 rendered '75.00', the recorded amount (single-row side, so first and last row are the same row).

52.measure_note: Same rotated-landscape geometry, axis='x'. Column bands from h_rules_pct: Amount [5.45,15.41] / Purpose [15.41,32.98] / City [32.98,42.95] / Payee [42.95,85.18] / Date [85.18,94.11]. No v_rules detected, so the three row bands were HAND-MEASURED from an exploratory strip crop (x=14.0..34.0) that rendered the printed row rules at 13.95 / 18.77 / 21.73 / 24.49 / 27.24 / 30.30 / 33.15 pct: the header label 'Amount' occupies 13.95-18.77 and 18.77-21.73 is the blank spacer band, both excluded, and the three amounts fall in 21.73-24.49, 24.49-27.24 and 27.24-30.30 respectively. PROOF (A3): pct:21.73,5.45,2.76,9.96@p52 rendered '31.98' (row 1) and pct:27.24,5.45,3.06,9.96@p52 rendered '16.98' (row 3) - the recorded amounts, in order, so the bands are index-aligned.

contributions.note: candidate self-funding (joint with spouse). The Address cell prints a street line ONLY - the filer entered no city and no state, so donor_city/donor_state are honestly blank (left empty by the filer, NOT redacted by the county); the street itself is not carried (PRIVACY: city/state only). Contrast the cover, where the county DID black out the candidate's address block.

notes: Typed 2024 3-line filing, October-8 pre-election box checked, signed 10/4/2024; p50 cover (portrait), p51 Form A and p52 Form B, both bound as ROTATED LANDSCAPE sheets that poppler renders portrait - page ORDER is the form order here, but page ORIENTATION is not, and the frames declare axis='x' accordingly. The county blacked out the candidate's whole address block on the cover; on Form A the filer simply left the city and state empty behind a street line - a county REDACTION and a filer OMISSION on the same filing, recorded as the two different facts they are. This is the smallest 2024 county-office campaign in the chunk (1,575.00 raised cumulative). The cover's December-5 checkbox carries the county's own stale year ('through December 31, 2022' on a 2024 form) - a form-template defect, noted, not corrected.
